units.source_text: 在雪中缫丝、织布，在雪水里漂洗，在雪地上晾晒，从纺纱到织布，一切都在雪中进行。

en.t: They reel the silk and weave the cloth in the snow, wash it in snow water, and dry it on the snow; from spinning to weaving, everything is done in the snow.

units.source_text: 有雪始有绉纱，雪乃是绉纱之母也。

en.t: Only where there is snow can there be crepe silk; snow is the mother of crepe silk.

units.source_text: 古人在书上也曾这样记载过。

en.t: People of old also recorded it this way in books.
